name: Oki Tsubomi
source:
After being abandoned as a child by her mother because she was a Cast, the government chose her to be the protagonist personal maid. When she was devastated because she was abandoned because of her power the protagonist supported and cheered her, making her fall in love for him. After so many years these feelings only grew, but her position as maid made her unwilling to confess her feelings. She will do anything to support the protagonist, even support his love with someone else.

Because she was abandoned she developed a trauma towards her Cast powers and she becomes extremely nervous when she uses it. She hates her powers and wanted to be a normal girl so maybe her mother wouldn't abandon her.

Her Cast is Glass Shoes. Her right leg become adorned with a boot that can walk in the air and lance Kamaitachis (air blades).

Her power is based on Cinderella. She should be very powerful if not for the trauma as she's a Princess Class Cast.
